item.title: What is the difference between phone call quality on different networks?
item.description: Phone call quality varies dramatically between networks due to technology differences, infrastructure investment, and spectrum allocation. VoLTE and 5G deliver clearer calls than older 3G systems, while carrier-specific factors like tower density and backhaul capacity create noticeable quality differences even in the same location.
